explication: Impeccable is a design-guidance toolkit for AI coding agents, combining skill commands with deterministic frontend checks and live browser iteration. The principal workflow is an agent invoking a design command or scan, the engine loading project context or inspecting HTML/browser state, and findings guiding changes. The graph also includes the documented browser extension and setup/context capabilities. Source excerpts are partial, so some subsystem connections are limited to those supported by the tree, README, or explicit excerpts.
